newsitem.title: USA: Monterey Resources adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Monterey Resources adopts rights plan.

text.p: Monterey Resources said on Wednesday that it has adopted a shreholder rights plan to deter coercive takeover tactics.
The rights plan was adopted as part of the company's obligation to Santa Fe Energy Resources Inc, which is spinning off its 83 percent stake in Monterey to Santa Fe shareholders.

Monterey said in a statement that the rights plan, which expires August 31, 1999, is effective after a person or group acquires 15 percent of the company's stock or makes a tender offer for that amount.
Monterey Resources conducted an initial public offering on November 14, 1996 and the rights plan is not a response to any known takeover plan, a company spokeswoman said.
